_meta.purpose: ExerciseIdentity: the immutable identity of an exercise. Every name/alias and every stored representation — Log_Cleaned.canonical_exercise / lift_code / muscle_group, the Exercise_Catalog row, and the knowledge-base ontology entry in config/coaching/schemas/exercise.schema.json — is a PROJECTION of this identity. Read-only, pure; NOT yet wired. The Phase 5b immutable exercise-identity registry consumes it (docs/EXERCISE_NAME_UNIFICATION_MIGRATION_PLAN.md, finding H-11).
_meta.movement_pattern_source: config/coaching/movement-patterns/patterns.json is the single owner of the movement_pattern enum; the ExerciseIdentity validator loads pattern ids from there so the vocabulary is never duplicated. A contracts-integrity test guards patterns.json ↔ exercise.schema.json alignment.
